name: Hold Breath In Tank
steps: Tap the water plant to breathe its oxygen bubbles.
Drag the swim ring to her mouth for air.
Tap the old tire to release trapped air.
Tap the pink fish to make bubbles.
Tap the turtle to release air bubbles.
Squeeze the floating doll to release trapped air.
Attach the tube to the cracked pipe for fresh air.
Use the boba straw with the bamboo pole to keep breathing.
